Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1 (A.2), A1.E2 and the between-jump paragraph A1.SS1.p2.2, with nonaccumulation p3.7. The joint measurable physical-time representative and initialization adapter is an ASTIS completion of an implicit construction step, not a quotation or the full Proposition3.1.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. This is an ASTIS source-implicit measurable realization of Appendix A.1's actual between-jump prescription, not the full process/Markov/invariance/main sampler/error/query-cost/composition theorem. No positive dimension, energy, cap, selector, nonexplosion, positive support, measurable flow or higher regularity certificate is a new premise.

    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))

For every ambient space and parameters described below, if the six hypotheses hold, the literal definitions below admit a total jointly measurable function Z satisfying exactly the four conclusion clauses, with the pointwise and almost-everywhere scopes specified below.

OBJECTS:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, V:E->R a potential, alpha,beta nonnegative real numbers, and eta a real number. Write g=gradient V, and D(DV)(x)[v][v] for the displayed second Frechet derivative applied twice to v. Put Omega=R^N and P=the countable product, indexed by N, of the rate-one exponential measure on R. For sample in Omega set epsilon(sample)(k)=max(sample(k),0), regarded as a nonnegative real. For y,r in E define c(y,r)=y-eta*g(r). For z=(q,p) in E x E and real s define Phi(y,r,s,(q,p))=(c(y,r)+cos(s)*(q-c(y,r))+sqrt(eta)*sin(s)*p, -sin(s)/sqrt(eta)*(q-c(y,r))+cos(s)*p), where scalar multiplication is that of E. Define S(r,(q,p))=(q,p-[2< p,g(q)-g(r)>/||g(q)-g(r)||^2]*(g(q)-g(r))). Define rate(r,(q,p))=sqrt(eta)*max(0,<p,g(q)-g(r)>). For nonnegative t define Lambda(y,r,z,t)=the real interval integral from 0 to t of rate(r,Phi(y,r,s,z)) ds. Define tau(y,r,z,e), for nonnegative e, as the infimum in [0,infinity] of nonnegative t satisfying Lambda(y,r,z,t)-e in [0,infinity), equivalently Lambda(y,r,z,t)>=e, with infinity if there is no such time. A record lies in ([0,infinity) x (E x E)) disjoint-union Unit. next(y,r,e,stopped)=stopped; for a finite record (u,z), next is stopped if tau(y,r,z,e)=infinity, and otherwise it is the finite record (u+tau(y,r,z,e),S(r,Phi(y,r,tau(y,r,z,e),z))). record(y,r,z0,e,0) is the finite record (0,z0), and record(y,r,z0,e,k+1)=next(y,r,e(k),record(y,r,z0,e,k)). eventTime(y,r,z0,e,n) is the accumulated time of the finite nth record, or infinity for a stopped record. All these are literal definitions, not additional assumptions. The existential object is a total function Z(y,r,z0,t,sample) with values in E x E.

DOMAINS:
E carries NormedAddCommGroup, InnerProductSpace R, FiniteDimensional R, MeasurableSpace and BorelSpace structures; its measurable structure is the Borel one and dimension zero is allowed. V maps all E to R. alpha and beta belong to NNReal=[0,infinity), with their real casts used in analytic expressions; eta belongs to R. y and r=xRef range independently over all E; z0 and the intermediate states z range over all E x E. The flow argument s is any real number, while t, local waiting thresholds e, accumulated times u and sequence entries e(k) belong to NNReal. sample is any real sequence N->R, including sequences with nonpositive coordinates; epsilon converts each coordinate to NNReal. n and k range over N, including zero. tau and eventTime take values in WithTop NNReal=[0,infinity], while a finite record a=(u,z) belongs to NNReal x (E x E); the other sum alternative is Unit, carrying no state. Z has full domain E x E x (E x E) x NNReal x (N->R), interpreted with the displayed currying. Joint measurability is for the equivalent uncurried domain ((E x E) x (E x E)) x (NNReal x (N->R)), with products right-associated as in Lean, and target E x E. These spaces use their displayed Borel/countable product measurable structures.

QUANTIFIERS:
Universally quantify over the ambient E and its displayed structures and over V, alpha, beta and eta. Under the six analytic hypotheses, define P, epsilon, c, Phi, S, rate, Lambda, tau, next, record and eventTime by the displayed lets, then existentially quantify one total Z. The conjunction after this existential first asserts joint measurability. Its second part universally quantifies, in order, y,r:E, z0:E x E, sample:N->R, t:NNReal, n:N and a:NNReal x (E x E), and makes the three stated premises imply the flow equality. Its third part universally quantifies y,r,z0,sample,t in that order and makes absence of any bracketing n imply the fallback equality. Its fourth part universally quantifies y,r,z0 BEFORE the P-almost-everywhere sample quantifier. Inside that almost-everywhere scope is the conjunction of (for every nonnegative t, there exist n:N and a:NNReal x (E x E) satisfying all six displayed conditions) and Z(y,r,z0,0,sample)=z0. Thus a single jointly measurable Z serves all parameters; for each fixed y,r,z0 there is a P-full-measure set of samples on which ALL times simultaneously satisfy the existence conclusion and the initial condition. The statement does not supply one parameter-independent exceptional null set.

ASSUMPTIONS:
The only supplied mathematical premises, beyond the ambient structures and typed parameters, are: (1) 0<(alpha:R); (2) alpha<=beta as nonnegative reals; (3) V is twice continuously differentiable over R, namely ContDiff R 2 V; (4) for every x,v:E, (alpha:R)*||v||^2 <= D(DV)(x)[v][v] AND D(DV)(x)[v][v] <= (beta:R)*||v||^2; (5) 0<eta; (6) (beta:R)*eta<=1. The Hessian condition has its own pointwise universal quantification over x and v and includes both bounds in one conjunction. No trajectory, function Z, measurable selection, non-explosion assertion, integrability condition, positive dimension, initial distribution, relation among y,r,z0, or pre-existing process is assumed. No additional potential smoothness bound is a premise.

CONCLUSION:
There exists a total Z:E->E->(E x E)->NNReal->(N->R)->(E x E) with the following four conjuncts. (A) The uncurried joint map (y,r,z0,t,sample)->Z(y,r,z0,t,sample) is measurable. (B) For every y,r,z0,sample,t,n,a=(u,z), if eventTime(y,r,z0,epsilon(sample),n)<=t, t<eventTime(y,r,z0,epsilon(sample),n+1), and record(y,r,z0,epsilon(sample),n)=the finite record a, then Z(y,r,z0,t,sample)=Phi(y,r,(t-u as NNReal cast to R),z). (C) For every y,r,z0,sample,t, if there is no n satisfying eventTime(n)<=t<eventTime(n+1), then Z(y,r,z0,t,sample)=z0. (D) For each y,r,z0 and P-almost every sample, every t:NNReal admits n:N and a=(u,z):NNReal x (E x E) such that, simultaneously, eventTime(n)<=t, t<eventTime(n+1), record(n)=the finite record a, u<=t, (t-u as NNReal cast to WithTop NNReal)<tau(y,r,z,epsilon(sample)(n)), and Z(y,r,z0,t,sample)=Phi(y,r,(t-u as NNReal cast to R),z); on that same full-measure set Z(y,r,z0,0,sample)=z0. In (B)-(D), each abbreviated record or eventTime uses exactly the parameters y,r,z0,epsilon(sample). The conclusion asserts the stated measurable piecewise-flow realization, all-time almost-everywhere bracketing and initial value; it states no invariant distribution, convergence rate, expected event count, differentiability or continuity of sample paths, or separately quantified probabilistic transition-law identity.

SCOPES_SENSES:
The analytic assumptions are pointwise; the measurability and the two conditional rules (B),(C) are global assertions, with (B),(C) applying to every real sequence, not merely P-almost every one. Only (D) is almost everywhere, for each fixed parameter triple; its universal time quantifier lies inside that almost-everywhere quantifier, so it is stronger than a separate almost-everywhere assertion for each time. The bracketing is inclusive at eventTime(n) and strictly exclusive at eventTime(n+1); the local inequality in (D) is also strict. Subtraction t-u in NNReal is truncated to max(t-u,0); (D) explicitly ensures u<=t. Comparisons of finite times to eventTime use their WithTop casts. The stopped record has eventTime infinity, is absorbing under next, and has no state at infinity; no finite-state update is made when tau=infinity. untopD 0 returns the finite value, or zero at infinity, but the update is guarded before its use in the finite branch. tau is defined as a hit-set infimum and the definition alone is not an extra assertion that the infimum is attained. Nonpositive sample coordinates give epsilon=0; the definitions remain total and can allow zero waiting increments. The pointwise fallback rule covers any time for which no bracket exists, including exceptional sampling behavior; the assertion of a bracket for every time belongs to (D). The reflection coefficient uses total real division: when g(q)-g(r)=0, division by its squared norm is division by zero in Lean (equal to zero), so S leaves the state unchanged. eta>0 makes sqrt(eta)>0, so the flow's sqrt denominator is nonzero under the hypotheses. Lambda is the ordinary real interval integral evaluated at the finite nonnegative endpoint; no integral to infinity is in the statement. Gradient, Frechet derivatives, trigonometric operations and square root have their literal real/inner-product meanings. Equality of Z at time zero is explicitly asserted in (D), within its almost-everywhere scope; the text does not separately assert this equality pointwise for every sample. Nothing in the displayed proposition requires uniqueness of Z, uniqueness of the bracket index or state witness, or a common full-measure set for all y,r,z0.

CONSTANT_DEPENDENCIES:
alpha,beta,eta and V are globally fixed before Z is chosen. E and its structures are fixed at the same outer level. P is fixed solely as the product of rate-one exponential measures and does not depend on V,alpha,beta,eta,y,r or z0; epsilon is the fixed coordinatewise nonnegative-part map. c and Phi depend on eta,V,y,r; S depends on V,r; rate depends on eta,V,r; Lambda,tau,next,record and eventTime inherit the displayed dependence on eta,V,y,r and their state/threshold/sequence inputs. alpha and beta enter only through the hypotheses and the allowed choice of the witness, not as explicit arguments in the literal dynamical formulas. The witness Z can depend on all outer data E,V,alpha,beta,eta and the hypothesis witnesses; its displayed arguments are y,r,z0,t,sample, and it is chosen once for all of them. The P-null exceptional set allowed in (D) can depend on fixed y,r,z0 and on outer data, but not on t, because every t lies inside the same almost-everywhere assertion. The witnesses n and a in (D) may depend on y,r,z0,sample,t. All explicit numerical constants are fixed: exponential rate 1, initial/hitting-start time 0, reflection multiplier 2, and step restriction upper bound 1. No unspecified finite bound, universal constant, asymptotic constant, expected-cost constant or dimension-dependent estimate is asserted.

lesson.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. This is an ASTIS source-implicit measurable realization of Appendix A.1's actual between-jump prescription, not the full process/Markov/invariance/main sampler/error/query-cost/composition theorem. No positive dimension, energy, cap, selector, nonexplosion, positive support, measurable flow or higher regularity certificate is a new premise.
